newsitem.title: UK: Clean tanker market torpid, rates flat to down.
newsitem.headline: Clean tanker market torpid, rates flat to down.

text.p: The clean products tanker market was lifeless this week in almost all sectors with rates flat or sinking, brokers said.

"Virtually all areas, both East and West, have stagnated and the dearth of trading opportunities has reduced enquiry to a level whereby freight rates will be difficult to maintain," brokers E.A. Gibson said in their weekly tanker report.

They said the Middle East market remained very poor with tonnage building up in prompt positions. The last fixture to India was for 25,000 tonnes at W175, with cargoes of 28,000-30,000 tonnes on more modern ships fixed at around W190/195.

Rates fell further in the Mediterranean with 27,500 tonne naphtha cargoes done at W220 or lower and gas oil at under W200 for 30,000 tonnes. Caribbean rates remained in the doldrums at around W170, while the inter-U.K./Cont market was also depressed with some vessels ballasting to Gibraltar in a vain search for business, brokers said. --London newsroom +44 171 542 4088
